concepts.title: Properties of Acids and Bases
concepts.ncert_text: Acids are sour in taste and change the colour of blue litmus to red. Bases are bitter in taste and change the colour of red litmus to blue.

concepts.title: Indicators
concepts.ncert_text: Substances that change color or odor in acidic/basic media. Natural: Litmus, Turmeric. Synthetic: Methyl orange, Phenolphthalein. Olfactory: Onion, Vanilla.

concepts.title: Neutralization Reaction
concepts.ncert_text: The reaction between an acid and a base to give a salt and water. Acid + Base -> Salt + Water. It is generally exothermic.

concepts.title: pH Scale
concepts.ncert_text: A scale for measuring hydrogen ion concentration in a solution. 0 to 14. 7 is neutral, <7 is acidic, >7 is basic. pH = -log[H+].

concepts.title: Important Chemicals from Common Salt
concepts.ncert_text: Sodium Hydroxide (NaOH) via Chlor-alkali process. Bleaching Powder (CaOCl2). Baking Soda (NaHCO3). Washing Soda (Na2CO3.10H2O). Plaster of Paris (CaSO4.1/2H2O).
